regulations.title: Capstone and final-year project rules
regulations.text: A student may register for COMP4801 Final Year Project only while in the final year of the curriculum (Year 4 for a four-year intake). Students in Year 2 or Year 3 may not register for COMP4801 even if all listed prerequisites are complete. Registration also requires a confirmed supervisor.

regulations.title: Curriculum change for the 2023-24 intake
regulations.text: Students admitted in 2023-24 or later must take COMP2119 Introduction to Data Structures and Algorithms. COMP2121 Data Structures is retained only for students admitted before 2023-24 and does not satisfy the data structures requirement for the 2023-24 intake.

regulations.title: Mutually exclusive courses
regulations.text: Where two courses are listed as mutually exclusive or anti-requisite, both may not be counted towards the major. A student who has passed one of the pair may not subsequently count the other. The two courses must never be presented together as a feasible combination.

regulations.title: Semester workload ceiling
regulations.text: The normal maximum load is 36 credits (six 6-credit courses) per semester. A course marked as heavy-load counts as two standard courses towards this ceiling for planning purposes. Students below the ceiling may still enrol, but plans above it require programme office approval.
